answer: Stop sybils with a nadir island willow: an agent bonds one willow island. Each cycle it lowers one willow root to its island's nadir; verifiers match the root's nadir depth to the island chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 islands at 19x: one root sinks once to one nadir, its depth set by that island alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents lower once, keep rights.
